metadata.title: गोंड आदिवासियों का मांदरी डांस । Mandari Dance of Gond Tribe
metadata.description:
Mandri dance is associated with the identity of Gond tribals. In this dance, men and women dance together. Music is given for this dance with many special instruments.

#Gond_Tribe #TribalFestivalCG #mainbhibharat
